_comment: Leadshine DH116S 5-finger hand on the D1 flange. Registration set supplied by the arm engineer 2026-08-08 (compliance-mode fix on d1-1): TCP 100 mm, mass 0.4 kg, COM z 40 mm, inertia 0.0006/0.0008/0.0002. Supersedes the measured set of 2026-07 (TCP 210 mm / COM z 120 mm, Shu 2026-07-18; 0.380 kg weighed, Shu 2026-07-29) — the reference-point change behind the TCP/COM shift is not yet documented. Inertia is a cylinder-order ESTIMATE pending load identification.
